tools.name: forgecraft
tools.description: Setup-time tool for engineering standards. Diagnoses project state. Remove this MCP server after setup is complete to save tokens.

tools.name: forgecraft_actions
tools.description: Full ForgeCraft action suite. Use action='setup_project' to onboard, 'check_cascade' to verify GS steps, 'generate_session_prompt' for a bound prompt, 'audit' for compliance score. Remove after setup to save tokens.

action.description:
Operation to perform.

Available actions:
  setup_project       — onboard a new or existing project (two-phase: analyze then calibrate)
  scaffold            — generate project structure files (.claude/, hooks, docs stubs)
  check_cascade       — verify all 5 GS cascade steps complete before implementation begins
  generate_session_prompt — produce a bound session prompt for a single roadmap item (gated on cascade)
  generate_diagram    — generate Mermaid C4 context diagram from spec artifacts
  refresh             — re-sync instruction files after tag changes
  audit               — check project standards compliance
  review              — structured code review checklist
  set_cascade_requirement — revise a cascade step as required or optional
  set_release_phase   — set project release phase (development/pre-release/production)
  contribute_gate     — submit generalizable gates to the community registry
  verification_status — full per-project acceptance report
  add_project_gate    — add a project-specific quality gate
  list_quality_gates  — list all quality gates
  export_taxonomy     — export tag taxonomy
  generate_adr        — emit a structured Architecture Decision Record into docs/adrs/
  create_exception    — create hook false-positive exception
  review              — structured code review checklist
  list                — discover available tags/hooks/skills
  classify            — suggest tags for a project description
  add_hook            — add a quality hook
  add_module          — add a module scaffold
  configure_mcp       — configure MCP servers
  get_reference       — get design patterns/NFR/playbook/guidance
  convert             — generate migration plan
  verify              — run tests and score §4.3 GS properties
  advice              — quality cycle checklist
  metrics             — external code quality report
  get_verification_strategy — uncertainty-aware verification plan
  record_verification — upsert acceptance decision for a verification step

  close_cycle         — end-of-cycle gate: re-run cascade, assess gates, promote generalizable ones

  generate_roadmap    — generate a phased docs/roadmap.md from PRD.md + use-cases.md (gated on cascade)

  cnt_add_node        — add a new CNT leaf node (.claude/standards/<domain>-<concern>.md)

  start_hardening     — generate hardening session prompts (pre-release → rc → load test)

  read_gate_violations — read structured gate violation records from .forgecraft/gate-violations.jsonl

  layer_status        — report L1–L4 completion per use case; identifies spec gaps and automation depth

  generate_harness    — scaffold L2 harness probe files (Playwright, hurl, bash) from UC specs
  run_harness         — execute harness probes and report per-UC pass/fail

  propose_session     — pre-implementation impact assessment: spec delta, layer readiness, gates, checklist (run before generate_session_prompt)

  check_spec_consistency — scan all spec artifacts for structural gaps, hollow probes, ambiguity markers, orphan probes, and derivation chain breaks

  setup_monitoring    — generate docs/monitoring-spec.md from NFR contracts: exception classes, alert thresholds, SLO definitions, PII policy, property violation map. Required before T4 is operational.

  check_t4            — surface pending T4 production signals from .forgecraft/t4-signals.json. Run at session start. Each signal is a spec-level diagnosis from production exceptions — update the spec, then derive the fix.

Quick usage examples:
  To run a cascade check:              action="check_cascade"
  To generate a session prompt:        action="generate_session_prompt"
  To onboard a new project:            action="setup_project"
  To scaffold an existing project:     action="scaffold"

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the project root. Required for: setup_project, refresh, scaffold, generate, audit, add_hook, add_module, configure_mcp, convert, verify, metrics, record_verification, verification_status, generate_adr. Optional for: classify, advice, get_verification_strategy.

tags.description: Project classification tags. Used by: scaffold, generate, audit, review, add_module, configure_mcp, get_reference (not needed for resource=guidance), convert, list (as filter).

project_name.description: Human-readable project name. Used by: scaffold, generate.

output_targets.description: AI assistant targets (claude, cursor, copilot, windsurf, cline, aider). Used by: scaffold, generate, refresh.

tier.description: Content depth: core, recommended, optional. Used by: refresh.

resource.description: Sub-resource for list (tags|hooks|skills) and get_reference (nfr|design_patterns|playbook|guidance). Use 'guidance' to retrieve GS session-loop, context-loading, incremental-cascade, bound-roadmap, and diagnostic-checklist procedures on demand — 'guidance' does not require the tags parameter.

name.description: Item name. Used by: add_hook (hook name), add_module (module name).

language.description: Programming language. Used by: scaffold, add_module. Default: typescript.

description.description: Natural language description. Used by: classify.

dry_run.description: Preview without writing files. Used by: scaffold.

force.description: Overwrite existing files. Used by: scaffold.

sentinel.description: Generate sentinel CLAUDE.md (~50 lines) + .claude/standards/ domain files instead of one large file. Default: true. Set to false for traditional monolithic CLAUDE.md. Used by: scaffold, refresh.

apply.description: Apply changes (vs preview). Used by: refresh. Default: false.

merge.description: Merge with existing instruction files. Used by: generate. Default: true.

compact.description: Strip explanatory tail clauses and deduplicate bullet lines (~20-40% smaller output). Used by: generate, scaffold, refresh.

release_phase.description: Current release cycle phase. Controls which test gates are shown as required vs. advisory. Used by: setup, generate, refresh. Default: development.

scope.description: Review scope. Used by: review. Default: comprehensive.

scan_depth.description: Analysis depth. Used by: convert. Default: quick.

tag.description: Single tag filter. Used by: add_hook.

include_anti_patterns.description: Scan for anti-patterns. Used by: audit. Default: true.

custom_servers.description: Custom MCP servers. Used by: configure_mcp.

auto_approve_tools.description: Auto-approve MCP tool calls. Used by: configure_mcp. Default: true.

include_remote.description: Query remote MCP registry. Used by: configure_mcp. Default: false.

remote_registry_url.description: Remote MCP registry URL override. Used by: configure_mcp.

max_servers.description: Max MCP servers to configure. Used by: configure_mcp.

test_command.description: Test command override. Used by: verify. Default: npm test.

timeout_ms.description: Test suite timeout in ms. Used by: verify. Default: 120000.

pass_threshold.description: Minimum §4.3 GS score (0–14, 7 properties × 2) required for overall pass. Used by: verify. Default: 11.

include_mutation.description: Run Stryker mutation testing (slow, opt-in). Used by: metrics. Default: false.

coverage_dir.description: Path to existing coverage report directory. Used by: metrics. Defaults to coverage/ relative to project_dir.

item_description.description: Roadmap item description for this session. Used by: generate_session_prompt. Should include actor, behavior, and postcondition.

acceptance_criteria.description: Checkable acceptance criteria. Used by: generate_session_prompt. If omitted, defaults are generated.

scope_note.description: Explicit out-of-scope statement — what this session must NOT touch. Used by: generate_session_prompt.

session_type.description: Conventional commit type for session output. Used by: generate_session_prompt. Default: feature.

uncertainty_level.description: Filter verification strategies by uncertainty level. Used by: get_verification_strategy.

step_id.description: Verification step ID to record an acceptance decision for (e.g., 'write-hurl-spec'). Used by: record_verification.

phase_id.description: Verification phase ID containing the step (e.g., 'contract-definition'). Used by: record_verification.

strategy_tag.description: Tag whose verification strategy the step belongs to (e.g., 'API', 'GAME'). Used by: record_verification.

step_status.description: Acceptance decision for the verification step: pass | fail | skipped. Used by: record_verification.

recorded_by.description: Who recorded this decision (e.g., 'claude-sonnet-4-5', 'human', CI name). Used by: record_verification. Defaults to 'unknown'.

show_pending_only.description: Show only pending/failed steps. Used by: verification_status. Default: false.

notes.description: Evidence or justification for a verification decision. Used by: record_verification.

adr_title.description: Short imperative title of the architectural decision (e.g. 'Use PostgreSQL for primary storage'). Used by: generate_adr.

adr_context.description: The situation that forced this decision — constraints, requirements, forces at play. Used by: generate_adr.

adr_decision.description: What was decided and why this option was chosen over alternatives. Used by: generate_adr.

adr_alternatives.description: List of alternatives considered and why each was rejected. Used by: generate_adr.

adr_consequences.description: Positive and negative consequences of the decision — what becomes easier, harder, or constrained. Used by: generate_adr.

cascade_step.description: Which cascade step to configure. Used by: set_cascade_requirement.

cascade_required.description: Whether the cascade step must pass before implementation begins. Used by: set_cascade_requirement.

cascade_rationale.description: Why was this cascade decision made? Required for: set_cascade_requirement.

cascade_decided_by.description: Who made this cascade decision. Used by: set_cascade_requirement. Defaults to 'assistant'.

spec_path.description: Path to an existing spec file (markdown, txt, OpenAPI). Used by: setup_project (phase 1).

spec_text.description: Paste spec text directly (markdown prose, OpenAPI description, etc.). Used by: setup_project (phase 1).

mvp.description: Phase 2 answer: true = MVP stage (minimal ceremony, expect changes), false = production (full quality gates). Used by: setup_project (phase 2 — provide together with scope_complete and has_consumers).

scope_complete.description: Phase 2 answer: true = scope is finalized (proceed with full cascade), false = scope still evolving (lighter cascade). Used by: setup_project (phase 2).

has_consumers.description: Phase 2 answer: true = existing users or downstream consumers (behavioral contracts required), false = no consumers yet. Used by: setup_project (phase 2).

use_codeseeker.description: Phase 2 answer: whether to add CodeSeeker for semantic code search. Presented as Q4 in Phase 1. Defaults to true when omitted. Set false if you already have an equivalent semantic search tool. Used by: setup_project (phase 2).

use_playwright.description: Phase 2 answer: whether to add Playwright MCP for browser automation and E2E/API testing. Only asked in Phase 1 for WEB-REACT, WEB-STATIC, or API projects. Defaults to true when omitted. Set false if you already have an equivalent browser testing tool. Used by: setup_project (phase 2).

tool_sample_split.description: Phase 2 answer: how to handle a spec that conflates a generative tool with a specific named creative output (e.g. an AI ghostwriter spec that also describes a specific novel). tool_and_sample — build the core tool; write docs/sample-outcome.md with the creative work as the first acceptance test. tool_only — named content is illustrative, ignore it. content_only — the goal is the creative work itself; tool is an implementation detail. Only relevant when Phase 1 reports a tool_vs_sample_output ambiguity. Used by: setup_project (phase 2).

project_type_override.description: Phase 2: override the inferred project type when ambiguities were reported in phase 1. Examples: "docs", "cli", "api", "library", "cli+library", "cli+api". Provide this when the AI detected conflicting signals and you want to specify the correct interpretation. Used by: setup_project (phase 2).

cnt_domain.description: Domain prefix for a CNT leaf node. Lowercase kebab-case. E.g. 'tools', 'shared'. Used by: cnt_add_node.

cnt_concern.description: Concern name within a CNT domain. Lowercase kebab-case. E.g. 'routing', 'auth'. Used by: cnt_add_node.

cnt_content.description: Markdown content for a CNT leaf node (≤30 lines). If omitted, a placeholder is generated. Used by: cnt_add_node.

deployment_url.description: Override deployment URL for smoke test. Used by: start_hardening. Default: read from forgecraft.yaml or 'http://localhost:3000'.

skip_load_test.description: Skip load test phase (HARDEN-003). Used by: start_hardening. Default: true (skip when no load gates defined).

harness_uc_ids.description: UC ids to target (e.g. ['UC-001', 'UC-003']). Used by: generate_harness, run_harness.

harness_timeout_ms.description: Timeout per probe in milliseconds. Used by: run_harness. Default: 30000.

env_probe_force.description: Overwrite existing env probe files. Used by: generate_env_probe. Default: false.

env_probe_timeout_ms.description: Timeout per env probe in milliseconds. Used by: run_env_probe. Default: 30000.

slo_probe_force.description: Overwrite existing slo probe files. Used by: generate_slo_probe. Default: false.

slo_probe_timeout_ms.description: Timeout per slo probe in milliseconds. Used by: run_slo_probe. Default: 30000.

max_items.description: Maximum advice items to return. Used by: advise_session. Default: 5.

change_title.description: Short imperative title for the change (e.g. 'Replace JWT middleware with Clerk SSO'). Used by: change_request.

change_description.description: What is changing and what it affects. Used by: change_request.

change_type.description: Classification of the change. Used by: change_request. spec-change: PRD/use-cases update. breaking-api: public interface change. adr-supersession: architectural decision being replaced. gate-change: quality gate modification. dependency-update: external dependency version or replacement.

change_breaking.description: True if this change breaks the public API or contract for consumers. Used by: change_request.

change_breaking_details.description: Describe what breaks — which endpoint, field, or behavior is removed/changed. Used by: change_request.

change_supersedes_adr.description: ADR ID being superseded by this change (e.g. 'ADR-0003'). Used by: change_request.

change_affected_artifacts.description: Explicit list of spec artifact paths affected. Used by: change_request. If omitted, auto-detected.

changes_status_filter.description: Filter changes by status. Used by: list_changes. Default: all.

monitoring_force.description: Overwrite existing docs/monitoring-spec.md. Used by: setup_monitoring. Default: false.

t4_acknowledge.description: Signal ID to mark as acknowledged. Used by: check_t4. Example: 'sig-20260424-143022-001'.

t4_resolve.description: Signal ID to mark as resolved (spec update applied and deployed). Used by: check_t4.

t4_show_resolved.description: Include resolved signals in output. Used by: check_t4. Default: false.
